title: Learning Accelerator State
description: Shape of a persisted Learning-Accelerator state file (`.learning/state.json` by default, `~/.learning-accelerator/state.json` for the user scope). This schema is derived from the upstream Python schema at Learning-Accelerator/schemas/learning_state.schema.json, but the JavaScript kernel in lib/learning-store.js (defaultState / migrate / validate / validateExerciseSpec) is authoritative: every top-level key and every section key listed here is one that defaultState() emits, and every `$defs.required` list is the set of keys the kernel always writes for that record. Divergences from upstream are noted on the affected field and summarized here: (1) AttemptRecord.user_answer is optional because recordAttempt only writes it when the caller supplies one and JSON serialization drops an undefined value; (2) ExerciseSpec.goal may be the empty string, since validateExerciseSpec materializes the key but only rejects an empty `task` or an empty `concepts` list; (3) `required` inside $defs describes kernel output rather than a validation gate, because LearningStore.validate() only enforces the top-level sections, topic_state.level, and difficulty_state.current_difficulty; (4) $defs for DifficultyEvidence, CurrentTask, ExerciseRecord, and CodeErrorRecord are extensions that upstream left as untyped objects; (5) ReviewItem also carries the completed_result/completed_at/notes fields that completeReview() appends when archiving an item into review_history. Every object keeps additionalProperties: true, matching the kernel's deepMerge(), which preserves unknown keys written by other tools or by newer versions.

schema_version.description: Persisted schema version. Must equal the SCHEMA_VERSION export of lib/learning-store.js; LearningStore.validate() rejects any other value.

learner_profile.description: Onboarding answers and constraints. Written by LearningStore#updateProfile(); migrate() back-fills known_skills, learning_domain, target_outcome, and target_project for older files.

learning_domain.description: Learning domain selecting the onboarding template. Known values are the DOMAIN_TEMPLATES keys: general, technology, language, exam, writing, communication. updateProfile() does not validate it, so any string is accepted.

known_stack.description: Technologies or prior experience the learner brought in.

known_skills.description: Skills the learner already has. migrate() copies known_stack into it when the key is absent; updateProfile() mirrors known_stack into it when only known_stack is supplied.

preferred_language.description: Language to teach in, such as zh-CN or en. Defaults to zh-CN.

experience_level.description: Declared or inferred level, mirroring EXPERIENCE_LEVELS. updateProfile() rejects values outside this list.

learning_goal.description: What the learner wants to achieve, in their own words.

target_outcome.description: Concrete artifact or result that would prove success. updateProfile() keeps it mirrored with target_project.

target_project.description: Legacy name for target_outcome; updateProfile() and migrate() keep both keys in sync.

constraints.description: Constraints such as time budget or forbidden tools. updateProfile() appends one de-duplicated constraint per call.

topic_state.description: Current topic, concept lists, and per-concept spaced-repetition progress. Written by setTopic(), recordConcept(), completeReview(), and recordAttempt(); migrate() back-fills concept_progress.

current_topic.description: The single topic this track is on right now.

level.description: Difficulty level of the current topic, mirroring TOPIC_LEVELS. LearningStore.validate() rejects values outside this list.

mastered_concepts.description: Concepts recorded as mastered. recordConcept() and _applyReviewResultToConcepts() keep it disjoint from weak_concepts.

weak_concepts.description: Concepts recorded as weak. priorityReviews() gives these a ranking bonus.

concept_progress.description: Per-concept strength, streak, and due date, keyed by concept name. Empty by default; migrate() back-fills an empty object.

misconceptions.description: Diagnosed misconceptions. Seeded empty by defaultState() and not written by the kernel itself.

open_questions.description: Questions the learner still has open. Seeded empty by defaultState() and not written by the kernel itself.

practice_state.description: Exercise specs, attempts, receipts, and queued tasks. Written by addExerciseSpec(), recordAttempt(), addTask(), and recordExercise(); the mistake tool also appends to last_code_errors.

exercise_specs.description: Registered exercise specifications, upserted by id via addExerciseSpec().

attempt_records.description: Append-only attempt log written by recordAttempt().

completed_exercises.description: Exercises recorded with status 'completed', upserted by id via recordExercise().

failed_exercises.description: Exercises recorded with status 'failed', upserted by id via recordExercise().

current_tasks.description: Queued next tasks. addTask() writes the record shape, and migrate() converts legacy current_project_tasks strings into it.

current_project_tasks.description: Legacy string-only task names, kept in sync with current_tasks by addTask() and migrate().

last_code_errors.description: Recent diagnosed mistakes, trimmed to the last 20. Written by the plugin's mistake tool (lib/tools.js), not by the store kernel; upstream left this as an untyped array.

review_state.description: Spaced-repetition queue and archive. addReview() and completeReview() maintain next_review_items and review_history; due_items is a queue slot the kernel reads (via dueReviews/priorityReviews) and migrate() normalizes rather than filling.

due_items.description: Review items that are ready to be asked; treated as due together with next_review_items whose due_at has passed.

next_review_items.description: Scheduled review items, upserted by id via addReview(), _scheduleReviewInState(), and completeReview().

review_history.description: Append-only archive of completed reviews. completeReview() pushes the matched item plus completed_result, completed_at, and (when supplied) notes.

difficulty_state.description: Adaptive difficulty calibration. _recordEvidenceInState() appends evidence and re-ranks, keeping at most the last 20 entries.

current_difficulty.description: Current difficulty step. LearningStore.validate() rejects non-integers and values outside 1-5.

evidence.description: Recent difficulty signals, capped at the last 20 by the kernel. Two same-polarity signals in a row move current_difficulty by one step; difficulty_state.evidence is not validated for length, so files written by other implementations may hold more.

next_adjustment.description: Direction implied by the two most recent evidence signals; reads 'same' when they disagree or are unknown.

ConceptProgress.description: One topic_state.concept_progress entry, written in full by _updateConceptProgressInState() on every review completion and attempt.

strength.description: Recall strength, clamped to 0-1 and rounded to two decimals. Starts at an implicit 0.5 baseline, +0.1 per correct/ pass, +0.2 per second_correct/third_correct, -0.2 per failure.

attempts.description: Total number of recorded reviews and attempts for this concept.

correct_streak.description: Consecutive correct recalls; reset to 0 by any incorrect or fuzzy result.

last_reviewed_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent update.

next_due_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the concept is next due: +1/+3/+7 days by correct_streak, or today after a failure.

failure_count.description: Consecutive failures; reset to 0 by a correct recall. priorityReviews() adds 3 priority points per failure.

ExerciseSpec.description: One practice_state.exercise_specs entry. validateExerciseSpec() materializes every listed key, so all of them are required in kernel-written state; `goal` may be an empty string because only `concepts` (at least one) and a non-empty `task` are rejected.

id.description: Stable 12-hex-character id derived from topic, concepts, difficulty, and task (stableId), or the id supplied by the caller.

concepts.description: Concepts the exercise covers; validateExerciseSpec() rejects an empty list.

difficulty.description: Exercise difficulty, mirroring EXERCISE_DIFFICULTIES. validateExerciseSpec() rejects anything else.

goal.description: What the exercise tests. Defaults to 'Practice <concepts>' in createExerciseSpec(), but validateExerciseSpec() accepts an empty string.

task.description: The learner-facing task; validateExerciseSpec() rejects an empty or whitespace-only value.

input.description: Optional input material for the exercise; defaults to an empty string.

expected_output.description: Expected behaviour or artifact; defaults to an empty string.

constraints.description: Required boundaries for the answer; defaults to an empty list.

evaluation_criteria.description: How the answer is judged; defaults to an empty list.

hint.description: One optional hint, hidden until needed; defaults to an empty string.

created_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the spec was registered; defaults to today.

AttemptRecord.description: One practice_state.attempt_records entry, appended by recordAttempt(). Upstream also required user_answer; the kernel only writes that key when the caller supplies one, so it is optional here.

id.description: Stable 12-hex-character id derived from the exercise id, the date, and the attempt count.

exercise_id.description: Id of the exercise spec this attempt answers; recordAttempt() rejects an unknown id.

user_answer.description: The learner's answer, passed through unchanged. May be absent: recordAttempt() does not default it, and JSON serialization drops an undefined value.

result.description: Attempt outcome, mirroring ATTEMPT_RESULTS. recordAttempt() rejects anything else. 'pass' schedules reviews as correct; anything else schedules them as incorrect.

score.description: Score from 0 to 100. recordAttempt() rejects non-integers and out-of-range values.

mistake_type.description: Misconception category; defaults to an empty string.

feedback.description: Evaluator feedback; defaults to an empty string and is reused as the review prompt when non-empty.

concepts_to_review.description: Concepts queued for review; defaults to the concepts of the attempted spec.

created_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the attempt.

ReviewItem.description: One spaced-repetition item, as stored in review_state.due_items, next_review_items, and review_history. createReviewItem() always writes these seven keys; completeReview() additionally stamps completed_result, completed_at, and sometimes notes onto the archived copy.

id.description: Stable 12-hex-character id derived from the concept and prompt (stableId('review', ...)); migrate() back-fills it for legacy items that lack one.

prompt.description: The recall question shown to the learner.

source.description: Where the item came from; defaults to 'manual'. Existing callers also use 'attempt' (recordAttempt) and 'diagnosis' (the mistake tool).

result.description: Scheduled recall outcome, mirroring REVIEW_RESULTS. It selects the interval: correct 1 day, second_correct 3 days, third_correct 7 days, incorrect and fuzzy 0 days.

created_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the item was created.

due_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the item becomes due, derived from created_at plus the interval for result.

completed_result.description: Recall outcome of the completed review. Present only on archived review_history entries.

completed_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the review was completed. Present only on archived review_history entries.

notes.description: Free-form completion notes. Present only on archived review_history entries, and only when completeReview() was given notes.

DifficultyEvidence.description: One difficulty_state.evidence entry, appended by _recordEvidenceInState(). Extension over upstream, which typed this as a bare object.

signal.description: Raw difficulty signal. Recognized values are POSITIVE_DIFFICULTY_SIGNALS (exercise_completed, explain_correct, recall_correct) and NEGATIVE_DIFFICULTY_SIGNALS (exercise_failed, recall_incorrect, explain_fuzzy, setup_failed). The kernel does not validate it: unknown signals are recorded and ignored when re-ranking.

detail.description: What the signal refers to, always coerced to a string.

source.description: Who recorded the signal; defaults to 'manual'.

recorded_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the evidence was recorded.

CurrentTask.description: One practice_state.current_tasks entry, written by addTask() and by migrate() when it converts legacy current_project_tasks strings. Extension over upstream, which typed this as a bare object.

id.description: Stable 12-hex-character id derived from the task name (stableId('task', name)).

notes.description: Free-form notes; defaults to an empty string.

status.description: Task status; the kernel only ever writes 'pending'. Not validated, so a downstream tool may set other values.

created_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the task was queued.

ExerciseRecord.description: One practice_state.completed_exercises or failed_exercises entry, written in full by recordExercise(). Extension over upstream, which typed these as bare objects.

id.description: Stable 12-hex-character id derived from the exercise name (stableId('exercise', name)).

notes.description: Free-form notes; defaults to an empty string.

status.description: Receipt status; recordExercise() rejects anything else and files the record under the matching list.

completed_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when status is 'completed', otherwise an empty string.

failed_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when status is 'failed', otherwise an empty string.

CodeErrorRecord.description: One practice_state.last_code_errors entry, written by the plugin's mistake tool (lib/tools.js >= action 'mistake') and trimmed to the last 20. Extension over upstream, which typed it as an untyped array.

id.description: Timestamp-derived id (base-36 clock value plus the joined concept names), not a stableId hash.

concepts.description: All diagnosed concepts; the tool rejects an empty list.

mistake_type.description: Misconception category; defaults to an empty string.

detail.description: Diagnosis text taken from feedback, notes, or mistake_type.

recorded_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the diagnosis.

concept_progress.description: Upstream-Python alias for ConceptProgress; kept so files and tools written against the upstream $defs name keep resolving.
